svg.desc: A textured midnight star chart with a detailed waxing gibbous Moon, rendered from NASA lunar terrain data. IC design, frontier AI jailbreak research, and native systems.
svg.metadata: Moon: NASA Scientific Visualization Studio. Ernie Wright (USRA), Noah Petro (NASA/GSFC). Source: https://svs.gsfc.nasa.gov/5587/ — named phase waxing gibbous. Lunar terrain from LRO / LOLA / LROC. See CREDITS.md.
